description:
Cefadroxil 500mg — 14 Capsules (Generic for Duricef®) is an antibiotic prescribed for the management of bacterial infections under the direction of a qualified physician. Each unit is dispensed in its sealed manufacturer packaging from our Cabo facility with full batch traceability.

Typical use involves completing the full prescribed course even if symptoms improve early, to reduce the risk of bacterial resistance. Inform your healthcare provider of any allergies or prior antibiotic reactions before starting therapy.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Same-day delivery available within Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.
